observed_content: Exact signed-orbit commutant certificate for the 78-dimensional determinant-isotypic sector of O2(F3) on three rank slots. Four adjacent signed-permutation shears and three order-three phase operators produce exactly one-dimensional commutant over C. Pair-orbit enumeration covers all 6084 entries; seven initial signed orbits, six eliminated, one surviving diagonal identity. With only first slot pair coupled, commutant dimension 15.

retrieval_log.surface: Local Python standard-library exact integer signed-permutation orbit execution
retrieval_log.result: PASS; 78 signed orbit basis elements each of size 8; 6084 matrix entries covered; full commutant dimension 1; incomplete generator commutant 15; 2496 signed basis-action and 1872 phase invariance checks.

claims: Irreducibility of the 78-dimensional complex representation under the tested phase and shear subgroup, via exact scalar commutant.
No full automorphic theta correspondence or RH result follows.
hypotheses: Identify precisely the image of the tested subgroup in Sp6(F3); compare to global theta-lift assumptions.
limitations: Exact certificate applies to a finite group action and its determinant-isotypic sector, not the paper's global automorphic objects.
No evidence of causal use of ROOT0 corpus.
